text:
Elaine: quick idea — add a tiny 'marginal cost' column on the per-route cost card (next to amortized unit cost). show per-token marginal after cache credits so engineers can decide route/canary splits quickly.
Mike: +1 but make the default 'amortized' and let people toggle to 'marginal' — product confusion risk if we surface both without context.
Nina: implementation question: do we compute marginal on the fly by joining token events -> cache_hits -> prefetch_credits? that join looks expensive at scale.
deploy-bot: feature-flag created: costpanel_marginal_preview (status: gated to org:eng-platform) :gear:
Sam: we already emit token_cost_raw and cache_credit events; the heavy part is attributing prefetch/shared-cache credits across multiple routes. precompute hourly aggregates? realtime approximate for top N routes?
Kevin: precompute + realtime approximation sounds right. UX: show a confidence/latency hint: e.g. 'marginal (approx, last refresh 5m)' vs 'amortized (hourly)'. keep toggle prominent.
Aisha: attribution rule suggestion — prefetch credits go to origin route by default; if the cache entry is used by multiple routes within the same session window, split proportionally by token consumption. document this clearly.
Mike: SQL sketch for a rollup (very rough):
```sql
WITH roll AS (
  SELECT model_sku, route, date_trunc('hour', ts) AS hr,
         SUM(token_cost_raw) AS total_cost,
         SUM(tokens) AS total_tokens,
         SUM(cache_credit) AS cache_credits
  FROM token_events JOIN cache_events USING (request_id)
  WHERE ts >= now() - interval '30 days'
  GROUP BY model_sku, route, hr
)
SELECT model_sku, route, hr,
       total_cost / NULLIF(total_tokens,0) AS amortized_unit_cost,
       (total_cost - cache_credits) / NULLIF(total_tokens,0) AS marginal_unit_cost
FROM roll;
```
Nina: that helps, thanks. note: joining on request_id is ok for rollups but not for realtime  p99 queries. we should add a reservoir sample stream for live panels to avoid scanning full joins.
Sam: ops concern — adding more rollups will increase storage and pipeline cost. propose: store hourly rollups for top 1000 routes, sample-based rollups for the rest. also add a toggle to exclude prefetch credits (for debugging).
Elaine: can someone run a perf probe? specifically measure query cost for: (a) hourly precompute join, (b) realtime approx using reservoir sampling and approximate cache attribution. if both look fine we can flip the flag to org-wide.
Nina: I'll open a telemetry ticket to add a sample_rate param and the new rollup DAG, link it to infra/cost-panel#456.
Sam: I'll mock up the console card with the toggle + small tooltip 'Why marginal vs amortized' and link to the doc.
Kevin: also add an explanatory axis in the per-model chart: show 'amortized' as baseline and overlay 'marginal' as dashed line for clarity.
Aisha: edge case note — chains and multi-model graphs: marginal per-model is tricky if downstream models cause tokens for earlier models. propose: show 'chain-adjusted' only in advanced view with clear caveats.
Elaine: perfect. moving to action items: Nina -> telemetry ticket, Sam -> UI mock, Sam/Kevin -> UX review, Ops -> perf probe (Sam volunteers), and I'll own rollout + docs. thanks everyone.
